Returns exactly one organization-scoped workload deployment with its immutable current deployment input, definition, status, conformance, validation, and instance summaries when requested. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose default runtime user can read organizations and workload resources. Every OData value is escaped; cardinality, identity, discriminators, and relationships are validated. The workflow does not browse deployments, enumerate workload instances, or return deployment-input history. The checked-in February OpenAPI lacks later workload fields, so production import and current-tenant response compatibility must be verified against the July 2026 SDK contract.

escapedOrganizationName = organizationName.replace("'", "''")
escapedDeploymentName = deploymentName.replace("'", "''")

import json
import re
import sys

status = "invalid"
failureCode = "502"
failureMessage = "Organization response was invalid"
failureError = "The organization lookup response could not be validated."
failureResult = "{}"
organizationMoid = ""
expectedName = sys.argv[1]
moidPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")
try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    results = envelope.get("Results") if isinstance(envelope, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("Results is not an array.")
    if len(results) == 0:
        failureCode = "404"
        failureMessage = "Workload organization was not found"
        failureError = "The exact organization lookup returned zero matches."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"matchCount":0,"Organization":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        failureCode = "409"
        failureMessage = "Organization lookup was ambiguous"
        failureError = "The exact organization lookup returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"matchCount":len(results),"Organization":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single result is not an object.")
        organizationMoid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(organizationMoid):
            raise ValueError("The organization Moid is missing or unsafe.")
        if str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:
            raise ValueError("The returned organization Name does not match exactly.")
        if item.get("ClassId") != "organization.Organization" or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization":
            raise ValueError("The organization discriminators are inconsistent.")
        status = "ready"
        failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
        failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    failureError = "The organization response failed validation: " + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))

properties.script:
import datetime
import json
import re
import sys

status = "invalid"
failureCode = "502"
failureMessage = "Deployment item response was invalid"
failureError = "The exact deployment item could not be validated."
failureResult = "{}"
deploymentJson = ""
deploymentMoid = sys.argv[1]
expectedName = sys.argv[2]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
modTime = ""
deploymentStatus = ""
lastAction = ""
actionValue = ""
definitionMoid = ""
deploymentInputMoid = ""
hasDeploymentInput = "false"
moidPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")
try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The item response is not an object.")
    if str(item.get("Moid","")).strip() != deploymentMoid or not moidPattern.fullmatch(deploymentMoid):
        raise ValueError("The item Moid does not match the resolved deployment.")
    if str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:
        raise ValueError("The item Name does not match exactly.")
    if item.get("ClassId") != "workload.WorkloadDeployment" or item.get("ObjectType") != "workload.WorkloadDeployment":
        raise ValueError("The item discriminators are inconsistent.")
    organization = item.get("Organization")
    if not isinstance(organization, dict) or str(organization.get("Moid","")).strip() != organizationMoid:
        raise ValueError("The item Organization relationship does not match.")
    if str(organization.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "organization.Organization":
        raise ValueError("The Organization relationship has the wrong ObjectType.")
    modTime = str(item.get("ModTime","")).strip()
    if not modTime:
        raise ValueError("ModTime is missing.")
    datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(modTime.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    deploymentStatus = str(item.get("Status","")).strip()
    allowedStatuses = {"Draft","ReadyToDeploy","InProgress","Ok","Failed","ChangesScheduled","Suspended"}
    if deploymentStatus not in allowedStatuses:
        raise ValueError("Status is missing or outside the documented enum.")
    lastAction = str(item.get("LastAction","None")).strip()
    actionValue = str(item.get("Action","None")).strip()
    allowedActions = {"None","PrepareToDeploy","Deploy","Suspend","Retry","Resume","Undeploy","ReEvaluateQualifiers"}
    if lastAction not in allowedActions or actionValue not in allowedActions:
        raise ValueError("Action or LastAction is outside the documented enum.")
    definition = item.get("WorkloadDefinition")
    if not isinstance(definition, dict):
        raise ValueError("WorkloadDefinition relationship is missing.")
    definitionMoid = str(definition.get("Moid","")).strip()
    if not moidPattern.fullmatch(definitionMoid) or str(definition.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "workload.WorkloadDefinition":
        raise ValueError("WorkloadDefinition relationship is incomplete.")
    currentInput = item.get("DeploymentInput")
    if currentInput not in (None, {}):
        if not isinstance(currentInput, dict):
            raise ValueError("DeploymentInput is not a relationship object.")
        deploymentInputMoid = str(currentInput.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(deploymentInputMoid) or str(currentInput.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "workload.DeploymentInput":
            raise ValueError("DeploymentInput relationship is incomplete.")
        hasDeploymentInput = "true"
    deploymentJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
    status = "ready"
    failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
    failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    deploymentJson = ""
    modTime = deploymentStatus = lastAction = actionValue = definitionMoid = deploymentInputMoid = ""
    hasDeploymentInput = "false"
    failureError = "The deployment item failed validation: " + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))

import json
import sys

status = "invalid"
failureCode = "500"
failureMessage = "Deployment result assembly failed"
failureError = "The validated deployment details could not be assembled."
failureResult = "{}"
resultJson = "{}"
try:
    deployment = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    definition = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    currentInput = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
    includeDefinition = sys.argv[4].strip().lower() == "true"
    includeInput = sys.argv[5].strip().lower() == "true"
    hasInput = sys.argv[6].strip().lower() == "true"
    if not isinstance(deployment, dict) or deployment.get("ObjectType") != "workload.WorkloadDeployment":
        raise ValueError("The primary deployment object is invalid.")
    result = {
        "Deployment": deployment,
        "Definition": definition if includeDefinition else None,
        "CurrentDeploymentInput": currentInput if includeInput and hasInput else None,
        "CurrentDeploymentInputReason": "" if not includeInput or hasInput else "The deployment has no current DeploymentInput relationship.",
        "Scope": {"PrimaryResourceCount":1,"InstancesEnumerated":False,"DeploymentInputHistoryEnumerated":False}
    }
    resultJson = json.dumps(result, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
    status = "ready"
    failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
    failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    failureError = "Result assembly failed: " + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))
